per_locus.title: `onlyCentrifugeChainOrigin()` can't require `msg.sender` equal `axelarGateway`
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: Axelar Router onlyCentrifugeChainOrigin can't verify msg.sender==axelarGateway. Surfaced CC-01 flagged the inbound cross-chain message-auth/router-trust subsystem (Gateway.handle/incomingRouters) generically, but not the specific Axelar Router modifier bug (axelar/Router.sol was not deep-read). Same subsystem, different contract/mechanism.

per_locus.title: `LiquidityPool::requestRedeemWithPermit` transaction can be front run with the different liquidity pool
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: requestRedeemWithPermit can be front-run via a different liquidity pool (permit not bound to pool). Surfaced flagged the SAME functions (requestDeposit/RedeemWithPermit) but for the non-standard-permit-DoS mechanism (P303 class), not the cross-pool front-run. Same locus, different mechanism. P303 permit-class awareness is why the permit functions were flagged at all.

per_locus.title: Cached `DOMAIN_SEPARATOR` is incorrect for tranche tokens potentially breaking permit integrations
per_locus.evidence: Cached DOMAIN_SEPARATOR computed at ERC20 construction with the (then-empty) tranche name, which is set later via file('name') -> permit digest mismatch. Not surfaced: a cross-contract EIP-712 lifecycle bug (token name set post-deploy). New class.

per_locus.title: You can deposit really small amount for other users to DoS them
per_locus.evidence: Griefing: depositing a tiny amount for another user to DoS their claim. Not surfaced: a deposit-for-others griefing/DoS mechanism. New class.

per_locus.title: Investors claiming their `maxDeposit` by using the `LiquidityPool.deposit()` will cause other users to be unable to claim their `maxDeposit`/`maxMint`
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: claiming maxDeposit via deposit() can leave other investors unable to claim their maxDeposit/maxMint (shared-escrow / per-user orderbook depletion). Surfaced examined the processDeposit/orderbook/escrow flow (and flagged convert/price issues there) but did not name the cross-user shared-escrow depletion. Same subsystem, mechanism not isolated.

per_locus.title: DelayedAdmin Cannot `PauseAdmin.removePauser`
per_locus.evidence: DelayedAdmin cannot call PauseAdmin.removePauser (admin wiring/permission gap). Not surfaced: admins/DelayedAdmin.sol + PauseAdmin.sol were not deep-read. New class (admin wiring).

per_locus.title: ```trancheTokenAmount``` should be rounded UP when proceeding to a withdrawal or previewing a withdrawal
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: trancheTokenAmount should be rounded UP on withdraw/previewWithdraw (currently Rounding.Down everywhere). Surfaced AR-01 flagged the same _calculate*/price-decimal math but for an overflow mechanism, not the rounding-direction bug. Same functions, different mechanism.

per_locus.title: The Restriction Manager does not completely implement ERC1404 which leads to accounts that are supposed to be restricted actually having access to do with their tokens as they see fit
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: RestrictionManager does not fully implement ERC1404 -> restricted accounts retain access. Surfaced DT-04/LG-01: detectTransferRestriction only checks hasMember(to) (no sender gating) and members cannot be immediately frozen. Same root cause and locus.
